description: Deep Work Plan benchmark record, v1 (spec/BENCHMARK.md). One closed JSON object per completed v6 plan, emitted into the plan's analysis_results/ by shared/benchmark.py when the repository opted into benchmark mode (.dwp/config.json or ~/.dwp/config.json). The record is derived, never imputed: every field comes from records the plan already owns (journal.ndjson events, manifest.json, contract.json, state.json, best-effort git diff stats). Quantities with no recording source are null - most notably tokens and spend, which exist only when resource_sample events were journaled by a metering host. The record carries no emission timestamp: two runs over identical plan bytes produce identical bytes (spec section 8). v5-generation plans are never measured. The subsystem is opt-in and never a conformance gate. The optional timing.task_spans and context_accounting fields are a pre-release v1 amendment (ADR-0005 in the skill repository): no released pack minted this $id before they landed, optional-only so every earlier committed record still validates.

plan.description: Plan folder name, same grammar as the journal's plan field.

title.description: Human plan title from the manifest.

generation.description: Only v6-generation plans are measured; the v5 line is frozen.

contract_id.description: The plan's materialized outcome contract id.

status.description: Plan status projected from state.json at derivation time.

dwp_skill.description: Version of the emitting pack (its SKILL.md frontmatter version).

spec.description: DWP standard the plan recorded (for example 6.0.0).

first_event_ts.description: Timestamp of the first journal event (the approval).

last_event_ts.description: Timestamp of the last journal event at derivation time.

span_seconds.description: Calendar span between first and last event. NOT compute time: sessions idle, hosts restart, humans review (spec section 3).

task_count_spanned.description: Number of distinct tasks with at least one task_start event - interrupted and retried tasks count once.

task_spans.description: Per-task calendar spans, one entry per distinct task_start event (an interrupted-and-restarted task carries one entry per start). Optional field: a pre-release v1 amendment; absent when the journal records no task_start events. Calendar span, not compute time (spec section 3).

start_ts.description: Timestamp of the task's task_start event.

end_ts.description: Timestamp of the task's completion evidence; null when the window holds no completion evidence for that start - never zero, never imputed.

span_seconds.description: Calendar distance start_ts to end_ts; null exactly when end_ts is null.

criteria.description: Acceptance criteria declared in the contract.

gate_intents.description: Sum of declared gate-intent criteria across tasks.

events.description: Total journal events at derivation time.

interventions.description: Count of intervention events (human or host break-ins).

refusals.description: Count of refusal events (every refusal is itself recorded).

retries.description: Count of gate_run events sharing a criterion with an earlier failing gate_run for the same task.

exit_nonzero.description: Gate runs that exited nonzero, including 124 timeouts.

observed.description: Evidence minted by a shipped executor itself (A1).

imported.description: Evidence carried in from outside the journal's own execution.

asserted.description: Claims by a mediating actor - never behavior.

flag.description: False unless resource_sample events were journaled by a metering host; never synthesized.

tokens.description: Summed token total from resource_sample events; null when not metered (spec section 3 - missing stays missing).

spend_usd.description: Summed spend from resource_sample events, unit USD; null when not metered.

repo.description: Repository name (basename only - the privacy boundary forbids absolute user paths, spec section 7).

branch.description: Branch name of the plan's repository at derivation time; 'unknown' outside git.

available.description: False whenever the git window could not be computed; the three counts are then null, never zero (spec section 3).

files.description: Files changed in the plan window.

context_accounting.description: The four-quantity context accounting block (spec section 3), each quantity from its own source, missing as missing. Optional field: a pre-release v1 amendment. Populated only when the plan's context accounting is recoverable at emission time; otherwise available is false and all four values are null - never synthesized.

available.description: False when the plan's context accounting could not be recovered at emission time; the four values are then null, never zero.

instruction_bytes.description: Measured static instruction bytes (the context manifest plus any declared bundle files); measured, not estimated.

provider_tokens.description: Latest observed token meter sample; null without resource_sample events. The same recording as metered.tokens, carried once more so the four quantities read as one unit.

cost_usd.description: Latest observed spend sample in USD, from real rates only - never bytes-to-money; null without resource_sample events. The same recording as metered.spend_usd.

wall_clock_hours.description: Recorded event ts span in hours; the same recording as timing.span_seconds, carried once more so the four quantities read as one unit.
